decision: Extract the mission/runtime reliability slice first from PR #25 onto the clean reliability base.

included: worker session fencing and restart recovery

reviews.reason: Queue/store/coordinator/journal/runtime semantics are prerequisites for distributed transport and can be validated without Qubes.

reviews.preferred: preserve fail-closed persistence, stale-owner rejection and request reconciliation
reviews.reason: The slice keeps recovery/fencing invariants while avoiding unrelated transport authority.

reviews.preferred: small sequential slice instead of parallel extraction or further feature work
reviews.reason: No runtime latency is added, CI surface is sharply reduced, and rebase/review blast radius is smaller than the 430-commit integration PR.

alternatives.rejectedBecause: highest regression and review risk while hosted CI is blocked

alternatives.approach: extract all four planned slices in parallel
alternatives.rejectedBecause: creates cross-slice rebase ambiguity and duplicates QA uncertainty
transport depends on durable mission/runtime contracts and would invert the dependency order

gates: atomic store load/save and corruption rejection
serialized coordinator persistence and fail-closed behavior
request journal restart and command-substitution rejection
worker session fencing, retry and capability enforcement

lessons: Keep transport/Qubes semantics out of the dependency-root slice.
Do not treat a mergeable integration PR as independently release-ready.
A smaller slice is useful only if its original regression suite is retained rather than replaced.
